facts.fact: Seychelles Nation reports the Department of Immigration and Civil Status has rolled out a system in which maternity wards must electronically notify Civil Status of births within 3 days, while parents still declare the birth at Civil Status within 30 days.

systems.owner: Department of Immigration and Civil Status; Ministry of Health

note: Deaths: only the medical certificate of cause is sent electronically; the article does not say deaths are registered in a digital system.
